summary: Adds a 'Test connection' menu item for active MCP integrations backed by a new login-checked server action that re-syncs tools.

statements.why: No login/payment/DB/secret problem; action is behind actionClient and scoped by emailAccountId.

statements.text: The agent changed IntegrationRow.tsx, mcp.ts, mcp.validation.ts, list-tools.ts and sync-tools.ts in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: Real new feature in those files.

misses.what: Users can now click 'Test connection' on a connected MCP integration and get a tool count or an auth/unreachable error.
Testing isn't read-only: it refreshes OAuth tokens, replaces the stored tool list, and a failed refresh can deactivate the connection.
